blocking_findings_resolved: English tasks previously received Chinese split prefixes; prefixes now follow task language.
OCR passage tasks previously accepted one arbitrary companion term; graders now accept all supported non-anchor terms.
Query reformulation previously allowed a first-search target hit; the task now requires an observed alias bridge, changed query and target-recall gain.
A memory-Web conflict fixture used a Git-specific prompt with a Python-document gold target; the prompt, hidden answer and frozen official source are now derived from one task contract.
The public calibration lane now contains representatives for all 30 capability families, so the 9B smoke does not need Sealed-B tasks or graders.
known_limitations: StudyHub preview OCR quality varies and some authentic tasks remain extraction-oriented.
A small number of cross-passage tasks use the same anchor in two distinct passages.
The internal research lane measures controlled multi-source synthesis, not general open-web Deep Research quality.
